policies.B1: Carrier preferred designation is granted when an operator maintains a minimum active fleet size of 10 coaches, receives an annual safety evaluation score of at least 85 points, and holds a valid Commercial Passenger Transport Licence.
policies.D1: Assignment to corporate transit agreements mandates an operator with carrier preferred designation who also maintains active 24-hour roadside assistance coverage.
policies.B2: Top-tier service rating is awarded if a travel provider demonstrates a quarterly on-time arrival rate of 95 percent or higher.
policies.B3: Access to municipal environmental subsidies requires a transportation firm to maintain a valid Green Transit Certification.

decoy_policies: A maritime transport firm obtains international route clearance provided it maintains a vessel cargo volume of at least 5000 tons and holds a Maritime Safety Certificate.
Passenger rail operators obtain express corridor clearance if their automated braking efficiency measures 99 percent or greater.

B1: Apex Tours has a fleet size of 15 coaches, a safety evaluation score of 92 points this year, and a Commercial Passenger Transport Licence, satisfying the requirement for carrier preferred designation.
D1: Apex Tours achieves carrier preferred designation and holds 24-hour roadside assistance coverage, satisfying the criteria for corporate transit agreements.
B2: Horizon Charter achieved an on-time arrival rate of 98 percent this quarter, satisfying the condition for top-tier service rating.
B3: Sol Express holds a Green Transit Certification, satisfying the condition for local eco-subsidy funds.
